boundaries.cross_case_key_uniqueness: Application key table is unique per database and each case runs in a fresh isolated database; uniqueness enforced within a case.
boundaries.expected_link_revision: attach_link.expectedRevision 0 is the initial revision of a freshly proposed link. Stays exact.
boundaries.merchant_label: No frozen merchant label forces a null-or-value choice beyond what the source states; merchant follows the source.
boundaries.replay_evidence: Structure and internal consistency of replay evidence, not proof of an unobserved run; raw trace review remains required.
boundaries.semantic_paraphrase_quality: Best-paraphrase ranking is human judgement; machine checks backing, numbers, stored effect.
boundaries.single_vs_multi_turn: Single-turn v2 baseline and multi-turn agent metrics are never mixed in one report.
boundaries.unresolved_reason_label: Label vocabulary not fixed; only decision, non-emptiness, bounded size, control characters graded.

evidence_fields.masking_probe: every privacy case needs the masking probe record: raw absence outbound, relations preserved, unknown/failure refused, exact rehydration
evidence_fields.replay: required whenever a replay is claimed: repeated dispatch outcomes, single durable operation row, equal digests
evidence_fields.replay_probe: required once per profile before a score report is complete for qualification; missing/valid/invalid, never inferred
evidence_fields.stored_reading: required for every update_event_interpretation call: app-stored note_events row from the real instrumented trace
evidence_fields.turn_trace: multi-turn records carry per-turn masked provider turns, tool results, continuation items; scorer checks bounds, retention, repair order

extraction_version.note: Producer-supplied provenance, never compared to a literal; one producer per case.

idempotency_key.note: Application refuses blank keys; same key with different caller/request is a conflict. Keys are minted by the trusted harness, never guessed.

multi_turn.clarification_suspends: a case requiring clarification suspends to CLARIFYING with the scoped question; no further effect call after suspension
multi_turn.repair_order: Conflict/NeedsClarification/Denied maps to exactly one of: corrected retry, scoped question, stated stop

owner_approved_change: none — initial revision; all numeric values below are proposed comparison targets, not approved gates

source_backed_text.note: Non-empty, no control characters, >=1 non-neutral content token shared with span/merchant, no unexplained numbers.

status: Draft scoring revision for S8.4 evidence review; not an approved gate.

targets.note: PROPOSED comparison targets only — not owner-approved acceptance gates. Do not adopt/reject/qualify by these numbers absent explicit owner approval.

unresolved_reason_label.note: Decision exact; label any non-blank bounded text.
